Fictional automatic-placement goldens. `expected.json` freezes manually measured
boxes in PDF points with a 2-point tolerance; production results are top-left
percentages on a 1-based page. A SIGNATURE box ends 1 point above its line; DATE
and empty NAME blanks have 13-point text boxes. Already printed names are evidence,
not new NAME fields. TITLE fields are outside C2a.

- `bare`, `nda`, `offer`, `roles`, `witness` and the signer JSON files are exact
  copies from the placement prototype supplied for C2a.
- `harbor.pdf` is decoded from the live fictional `send.json`'s `pdf_b64`.
  It is byte-identical to `nda.pdf` (SHA-256
  `6855abba8f7318e17f07b9f339eafa8f566c226fdae0ad5f29607a667bd422e5`);
  the separate golden tests the live Lee-only send rather than two signers.
- `unusual.pdf` is generated by `make_unusual.py`. Its local unusual label is
  resolved by a mocked model; the body sentinel must never enter model input.
- The supplied `bare.pdf` has generic Signature/Date blanks but no identity cues.
  It must return `bare`, with no model call or placed fields.

The checked-in expected geometry is independent of the placement result; do not
regenerate it from engine output. Run `dealroom_sign/tests/test_placement.py` in
Send CI. Rendering evidence and its reproduction script live under
`docs/implementation/c2a/`.
